description: Read the brand’s Pinterest CONVERSION TAGS — the Pinterest tag a WEB_CONVERSION or SALES campaign optimises on. view:"all" (default) lists every tag with status, when it last fired (a tag that has NEVER fired is not installed) and its code snippet; conversionTagId reads one tag in full; view:"ocpm_eligible" lists the (tag, event) pairs a conversion ad group can OPTIMISE for — put one in create_pinterest_ads_ad_group’s optimizationGoalMetadata as {"conversion_tag_v3_goal_metadata":{"conversion_event":…,"conversion_tag_id":…}}; view:"page_visit" lists page-visit events. Read-only, 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Pinterest ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

conversionTagId.description: read one tag in full — code snippet and enhanced-match config

includeDeleted.description: true also includes deleted tags in the list

view.description: all (default) lists tags; ocpm_eligible lists (tag, event) goals; page_visit lists page-visit events

name: list_pinterest_ads_conversion_tags
title: List Pinterest conversion tags
